mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a comfortable temperature of 68 degrees.

The City of Verona has several development items on the agenda for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including plans for Ardent Glen and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15.

It is a busy weekend. Today you can check out the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, enjoy yoga on October 26 and various trivia nights starting October 27.
In a notable incident from October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after responding to reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the ever-popular Turtle. Culver's is open today until 10:30 PM, so make sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop while you can.
